backend/main.mo: Defines authorization mixin and a large set of backend types for user profiles, props, live picks, settlements, diagnostics, and metrics.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping a frontend settlement-flow feature to involved files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-written summaries of many frontend files describing routing, pages, hooks, components, and state modules.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base/theme variables and dark mode tokens defining the app’s design system.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML document loading the React app and metadata including title, description, and favicon.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring React Query, theming, parlay state, router, and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/account/Principa: Card component displaying the user’s principal ID with copy‑to‑clipboard functionality and toast feedback.
frontend/src/components/alerts/MarketAle: Panel showing recent significant line‑movement alerts with icons, timestamps, and loading/empty states.
frontend/src/components/auth/AdminOnly.t: Wrapper that renders children only for authenticated admins and shows an access‑denied alert otherwise.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button using Internet Identity with automatic cache clearing and retry handling.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginRequir: Centered card prompting unauthenticated users to log in via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireAuth: Auth guard that initializes identity, auto‑registers users, shows loading states, and protects children.
frontend/src/components/error/ErrorState: Displays an error message with special handling for authorization errors.
frontend/src/components/landing/DailyTop: Shows a ranked list of top edge-based props with confidence indicators and add-to-parlay controls.
frontend/src/components/landing/LivePick: Renders a preview of up to three live picks for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/landing/Settleme: Displays settlement performance metrics with loading, error, and empty states.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main app layout with navigation, header, and parlay badge support.
frontend/src/components/live/LivePickCar: Shows a detailed interactive card for a live pick with higher/lower selection buttons.
frontend/src/components/live/LivePicksGr: Renders a responsive grid of live pick cards with selection handling.
frontend/src/components/live/LivePicksRo: Empty placeholder file for future row action components.
frontend/src/components/live/LivePicksSt: Provides buttons to filter live picks by game status.
frontend/src/components/live/LivePicksTa: Empty placeholder file for a table view of live picks.
frontend/src/components/loading/LoadingS: Shows a centered loading spinner and optional message.
frontend/src/components/parlay/AddToParl: Toggle button to add or remove a prop as a parlay leg, with a disabled state and tooltip at max legs.
frontend/src/components/parlay/CopySumma: Copies a text summary of parlay legs to the clipboard and shows success or error toasts.
frontend/src/components/props/Confidence: Displays a badge indicating high confidence with size‑adjusted icon and text.
frontend/src/components/props/PropBoardR: Renders action buttons for each prop row, including add‑to‑parlay and view‑details link.
Expandable section showing calculation details such as confidence, edge, lines, and verification summary.
frontend/src/components/props/ValueBar.t: Visual bar showing confidence percentage with color based on edge direction.
frontend/src/components/settings/Sensiti: Settings card allowing users to configure edge threshold, rolling window, and alerts, with save handling.
frontend/src/hooks/mutations/useGrantAdm: Mutation hook to grant admin privileges to a principal and refresh admin state.
frontend/src/hooks/mutations/useManualRe: Triggers backend data import and invalidates related queries, showing toast results.
frontend/src/hooks/mutations/useRefreshL: Refreshes live picks data and invalidates related queries with success and generic error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/mutations/useRunSettl: Runs settlement if caller is admin and updates related queries with detailed error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/mutations/useSaveCall: Saves the caller’s user profile and invalidates the profile query.
frontend/src/hooks/mutations/useSaveProv: Saves ingestion provider configuration and refreshes config state with toast feedback.
frontend/src/hooks/mutations/useTestOpti: Tests connectivity to Optic Odds API and reports failures via toast.
frontend/src/hooks/mutations/useUpdateSe: Saves sensitivity settings with validation and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/queries/useCallerUser: Fetches the caller’s user profile when actor and identity are ready, exposing refined loading state.
frontend/src/hooks/queries/useEdges.ts: Loads edges and attaches prop, projection, and verification details for each.
Fetches live picks with polling, enabled when actor and identity are available.
frontend/src/hooks/queries/useLivePicksD: Fetches live picks diagnostics from the backend with 15s polling, enabled when actor and identity are available.
frontend/src/hooks/queries/useLivePicksL: Retrieves the last-updated timestamp for live picks with 15s polling when actor and identity are ready.
frontend/src/hooks/queries/useMarketAler: Returns market alerts (currently empty placeholder) with 30s polling when alerts are enabled in sensitivity settings.
frontend/src/hooks/queries/usePropDetail: Fetches detailed player prop data for a given propId when actor and identity exist.
frontend/src/hooks/queries/useProviderCo: Loads ingestion provider configuration from the backend when an actor is available.
frontend/src/hooks/queries/useRefreshSta: Derives the most recent lastUpdated timestamp from NBA props to indicate refresh status.
frontend/src/hooks/queries/useSensitivit: Fetches user sensitivity settings tied to identity and augments query loading state.
frontend/src/hooks/queries/useSettlement: Retrieves settlement diagnostics for admins only, disabled for non-admin users.
Fetches settlement metrics from the backend when actor and identity are present.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to identity and invalidates dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity state, login, logout, and context management using AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsAdmin.ts: Checks whether the current authenticated caller is an admin using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind styles, theme variables, and a textured background for the app.
frontend/src/lib/edges/applyEdgeThreshol: Filters edges by a minimum absolute edge percentage threshold.
Computes combined hit-rate probability from confidence scores, handling missing values.
frontend/src/lib/parlay/exportSummary.ts: Generates a formatted text summary of a parlay including legs, stats, and aggregate metrics.
frontend/src/lib/verification/highConfid: Determines whether a verification result meets the high-confidence threshold.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Displays an About page with disclaimers, tool explanation, and responsible gambling guidelines.
frontend/src/pages/EdgeBoardPage.tsx: Fetches and filters edge opportunities, handling login, loading, errors, and empty states before rendering a list of qualifying edges.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Provides the marketing landing page with hero content, metrics, live picks preview, and top parlay suggestions when authenticated.
frontend/src/pages/LivePicksPage.tsx: Shows live picks with search and status filtering, handling ingestion diagnostics, admin error details, and various loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/ParlayBuilderPage.tsx: Manages the user’s parlay legs, showing empty, minimum-leg warnings, combined hit-rate calculations, and full parlay management UI.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Profile editing page that loads user data, allows updating name, favorite teams, and notification preferences, and saves changes.
frontend/src/pages/PropBoardPage.tsx: Displays a searchable, threshold-filtered table of prop edges with value indicators and user-dependent visibility.
frontend/src/pages/PropDetailPage.tsx: Shows detailed information for a specific prop including projections, edges, verification, and add-to-parlay options.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Admin and user settings page handling API keys, refresh actions, diagnostics, settlement controls, alerts, and sensitivity settings.
frontend/src/routeTree.tsx: Defines the application's route structure, including auth-protected pages and layout rendering.
frontend/src/state/parlay/ParlayProvider: Context provider managing parlay legs with add, remove, clear, and max-leg limit logic.
frontend/src/state/parlay/types.ts: Type definitions for parlay legs, including prop, line, edge, and verification metadata.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helper functions to read URL parameters (including hash routing), persist them in sessionStorage, and clear them from the URL or storage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining dark mode, content paths, extended color system, typography, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Defines current project state, including versioning, existing features, and new feature requests for implementing the prediction settlement engine.
